messages:
sofia: Heads-up 1: I ran into reader confusion where 429s, timeouts, and context-limit fallbacks are spread across 3 different pages. Proposing a single Troubleshooting > Error Reference page that includes a compact matrix, short SDK snippets, and cross-links to deeper guides.
kelsey: +1. Readers want one-stop for common runtime errors. Keep it short and pragmatic.
prashant: Can we include a tiny decision matrix mapping symptom -> immediate action -> escalation? Example: 
- 429 (rate limit) -> backoff + reduce batch or switch model variant -> contact support if persistent
- timeout -> idempotent retry w/ jitter -> increase timeout or route to local replica
- context_limit -> trim prefix or summarize history -> use embeddings + retrieval
ali: Add header examples for hosted vs dedicated. Dedicated can emit `x-rw-dedicated-window` (internal note) and hosted uses `Retry-After` / standard rate headers. Customers often only look at Retry-After.
sofia: I'll add a short "Deployment notes" callout. Also plan to show two minimal snippets (python + node) for parsing Retry-After and applying jittered backoff. Snippets must be 6-8 lines.
prashant: Here's a concise node snippet I drafted:```js
// simple retry with jitter
const retryAfter = parseInt(res.headers['retry-after'] || '0', 10);
const base = Math.min(Math.max(retryAfter, 1), 60);
const jitter = Math.random() * base;
await sleep(base + jitter);
```
ali: For context trimming, show before/after prompt length and a tiny pseudo function: `trim_history_to_tokens(history, max_tokens)` so teams know trimming is a legit fallback vs blind retry.
kelsey: Also add a short paragraph advising when trimming is NOT appropriate (e.g., critical transactional context).
sofia: Will do. I created PR draft and added a link to expanded examples repo: github.com/redwood-inference/playbooks/error-handling-examples.
docs-bot: PR created: #3507 "single-error-ref-page + compact sdk snippets" (labels: docs, needs-review)
prashant: Nit: normalize fallback names in the matrix: `trim_context`, `retry_with_backoff`, `switch_model_variant`, `route_fallback`. Makes automation easier.
sofia: Normalized names and added a tiny table mapping SDK helper calls (e.g., `client.fallback.trimContext()`) to fallback types.
ali: Please mention that some SDKs emit structured error bodies now (`error.code`, `error.meta`) and show how to inspect them quickly.
kelsey: Schedule a short reviewsync tomorrow 11am PT. If PR is green after review, we should update the changelog and ping support + eng-ops channels.
sofia: Added changelog blurb and a blurb for support. Ready for review. Thanks! :tada:
